result.reason: The operative language implements the fallback by limiting the termination payment to fees for three months and making it applicable only to convenience termination, not HDI breach. However, stating that it is the sole and exclusive amount payable “by reason of such termination” is broader than necessary and could unintentionally eliminate accrued fees or other ordinary termination obligations; it should instead be the sole liquidated damages or early-termination fee. The retained sentence beginning “Payment is determined” is also an uncorrected sentence fragment, reducing drafting quality.
